profiles.summary: Backend Web Developer with over 8 years of professional experience specializing in PHP and Laravel application development, REST API integrations, and backend system architecture. Experienced in building and maintaining scalable web applications, integrating third-party services, and developing custom solutions using Drupal and WordPress.
profiles.about: Contributed to projects for private-sector clients and government-related organizations in Malta, with hands-on experience in multi-tenant applications, e-commerce integrations, and headless CMS architecture. I collaborate with international teams to deliver maintainable solutions aligned with business requirements.

experiences.title: Backend Web Developer
experiences.description:
Develop and maintain Laravel backend systems for internal and client-facing platforms.
Design and implement REST API integrations between Laravel, WordPress, and WooCommerce systems.
Build data synchronization for orders, product pricing, inventory, and property information.
Develop custom Drupal modules, structured content, and Paragraph-based forms.
Expose structured Drupal content through JSON:API for headless CMS implementations.
Collaborate with project managers and developers across Malta and the Philippines.
Write maintainable code and support ongoing improvements to CMS-based websites and custom applications.
